[G]

[G]My attic is
[G/F#]full of pages, full of crazy
[Em]Cluttered spaces that you could not
[C]cross [D]

[Em]Young emotions that just won't grow
[C]up [D]

[G]I keep hiding the keys
[G/F#]in all these
[Em]Places even I can't find
[C]  [D]

[G/F#]them all And
[Em]I wanna let you see inside
[C]my [D]attic
[G]

[Verse 2]
[G]Inside this
[G/F#]olive skin are paper thin Il-
[Em]lusions that I'm tougher than I am
[C]  [D]
[G]And I'm guarded,
[G/F#]castle walls from all the falls And
[Em]break up calls and never should've beens
[C][D]But

[Chorus]
[G]don't go pushing too hard
[G/F#]I'm not so
[Em]easy to manipulate
[C]  [D]
[Em]I will give you all of
[G/F#]my secrets
[G]If you promise you can brave
[C]my [D]attic

[Bridge]
[Em]And I swear,
[G/F#]not tryna be vindictive
[C]I'm just terrified
[D]that you might see me different
[Em]You'll change your mind,
[G/F#]tell me that I'm crazy
[C]Tell me that I'm okay,
[D]tell me that you'll stay
[C]  [D]
[C]  [D]

[G]'Cause my attic is

[Em]numbers can't begin to calculate
